text:
jordan_lee: FYI customer (MedSys) wants an air-gapped POC. main requirements: USB deliverables, incremental patches (not full image each time), verifiable signatures, and clear upgrade cadence for their procurement team. they also asked for a per-site support price.

neha_patel: Confirmed we can do chunked delta bundles + signed manifests. caveats: agent must be >=2.3.1; delta format is our audited patch format (patch.v1).

tom_garcia: quick tech notes:
- apply tool: `redwood-offline-apply --manifest /mnt/usb/manifest.json --verify`
- signature verification supports both our signing key and customer-provided root CA (they can give us PEM)
- delta bundles are binary diffs for runtime + model shards; some model formats don't delta well -> fallback to full bundle for that model

jordan_lee: Pricing draft: baseline offline bundle + 1 quarterly delta = $15k/yr/site. monthly delta plan = $22k/yr/site. hotfix SLA (24h) add-on = $4k/yr/site. travel/support billed T&M.

eng-sales-bot: POC ticket created: POC-9082 assigned tom_garcia. link: https://app.redwood/POC-9082

neha_patel: Security checklist we need back from customer before SOW: preferred root CA delivery method, SBOM acceptance, KMS/HSM usage (do they want us to sign or they will), and telemetry opt-out confirmation.

compliance_ryan: also add: required retention period for logs/diagnostics, and whether they're ok with checksum-only verification in offline environment.

jordan_lee: plan for kickoff call Mon 9am ET. agenda: demo `redwood-offline-apply` on a VM, show manifest + signature verification, discuss delta constraints and pricing. can folks attend?

tom_garcia: Ill prep a sample manifest and a small signed delta image. example manifest (trimmed):
```
{
  "manifest_version":"1",
  "site_id":"medsys-east-1",
  "bundles":["runtime-3.2.tar.zst","models/petite-gptq-v1"],
  "delta":true,
  "signature":"MEUCIQD..."
}
```

neha_patel: i'll draft the SOW clause for offline cadence and the pricing table.

compliance_ryan: Ill attach the minimal questionnaire for them to sign and a sample CA exchange process doc.

jordan_lee: if we get their root cert beforehand we can demo verification end-to-end. thanks team. :thumbsup:
